schema.label: SIMULATED
rules: seq is contiguous from 0. uint width is maximum decimal digits; booleans are not integers.
fact_id is J:%08d or O:%08d using the source list index. source is JOURNAL or OVERLAY.
journal_position is the journal index or the raw overlay after_journal_index.
kind is the journal op or overlay kind: 1..32 ASCII letters, digits or underscore.
amount_krw is journal body.amount or overlay payload.amount_krw when present; it must be an integer in 0..asset.max_atoms, otherwise null only when absent.
sim_day is null for journal rows and the raw unsigned overlay sim_day otherwise.
duplicate is 1 only for an identical repeated overlay_id, ignored by fold; otherwise 0.
entry is the complete raw canonical JSON object; row_sha256 is lowercase hexadecimal.
Preserve both source list orders. Before each overlay entry emit remaining journal indices less than the running maximum of overlay after_journal_index; then emit remaining journal rows.
cut has state_digest, journal_length, fixtures_digest, cut_id. overlay_state_digest and overlay_entry_count are both present exactly when the overlay list is nonempty; never null.

Digests use capital.store.canonical_bytes and domain-tagged SHA256. Row material is {domain:ROW,row:row_without_hash}; chain genesis is {domain:CHAIN,cut_id,schema_sha256}; chain step is {domain:CHAIN,previous,row_sha256}; page material is {domain:PAGE,page:page_without_digest}; cut material is {domain:CUT,...cut_without_cut_id}. Domain constants are KIX_CAPITAL_FACTS_*_V1.
Cursor is kfc1.<next seq as eight decimal digits>.<cut_id>. Limits 1..500, default 100. Canonical ASCII JSON bytes have no trailing newline. Hashes detect corruption, not authentication.
